name: Bi Dashboard Spec
description: Produces a BI dashboard specification for a named business function including dashboard purpose, audience, KPIs displayed, panel layout, refresh cadence, access permissions, and alert thresholds. Outputs a complete spec ready for implementation in any BI tool. Use when the user asks to design a dashboard, create a dashboard specification, plan a BI dashboard layout, or define what should appear on a business dashboard. Do NOT use for individual KPI definitions with formulas (use kpi-definition), metric hierarchy design (use metric-framework), or data visualization chart selection (use chart-type-selector).
